playbookOutputs: Multiple Deeds Office Search Report (10 Deeds Offices)
Lodged 6-Part CoR 40.5 Reinstatement Dossier & CIPC Tracking Number
Catch-Up CIPC Annual Return Certificates for All Outstanding Years
Updated CoR 14.3 Disclosure Certificate Showing "In Business" Status
playbookCommonFailures: Certified IDs of directors or customer code holder are older than 3 months at the date CIPC processes the CoR 40.5 dossier
Documentary proof of economic value does not cover the deregistration period or does not show the company name
Immovable property is discovered on the Deeds Search without Public Works and National Treasury consent letters
Client delays settling CIPC statutory Annual Return turnover fees within 30 business days after reinstatement, causing CIPC to re-deregister the entity

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3 / CK1)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the original CIPC registration certificate or latest disclosure document.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3, CK1, CK2 or Disclosure Certificate showing the deregistered enterprise name, registration number, and listed directors/members.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copies of All Directors & Beneficial Owners (Not Older Than 3 Months)
alternatives: Certified & apostilled foreign passport (foreign nationals only)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified SA ID copies (< 3 months) for all active directors and anyone holding >= 5% shares.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Residential Address for All Directors & Beneficial Owners (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Required for the post-reinstatement CIPC Beneficial Ownership declaration so Annual Returns can be filed.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of residential address dated within 90 days in the name of each director/beneficial owner.

informationToProvide.label: Documentary Proof of Active Trading OR Economic Value at Deregistration Date (Bank Statement, Lease, Invoices, or Property Deed)
alternatives: Title deed of property in company name
Signed lease agreement or customer/supplier invoices
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload proof that the company was trading or held assets/liabilities at the time of deregistration.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Bank statement, property title deed, lease agreement, or customer/supplier invoices in the name of the deregistered entity proving economic value or trading activity.

informationToProvide.label: Dept of Public Works & National Treasury Non-Objection Letters (Required ONLY if Company Owns Immovable Property)
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: Does the company own any immovable property (land or buildings) registered at the Deeds Office?
informationToProvide.helpText: Required by CIPC if the Multiple Deeds Search shows property registered in the company name.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official letters from the Department of Public Works and National Treasury confirming no objection to CoR 40.5 reinstatement.

informationToProvide.label: Annual Turnover per Outstanding Financial Year & Shareholding / Beneficial Ownership Breakdown (%)
informationToProvide.helpText: List (1) the reason Annual Returns were missed, (2) annual turnover in Rands for each outstanding year, and (3) each Beneficial Owner full name, ID, residential address, email, cell, and % shareholding.

informationToProvide.label: Signed CoR 40.5 Application, Sworn Affidavit (Commissioned) & BO/Reinstatement Mandate
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the signed CoR 40.5 form, commissioned Sworn Affidavit, and signed Mandate once drafted for you.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed CIPC CoR 40.5 form, Sworn Affidavit stamped by a Commissioner of Oaths, and signed Reinstatement & Beneficial Ownership Mandate.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect CoR 14.3, certified IDs, proof of address, trading proof, and turnover history
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR 14.3, certified IDs (< 3 months), proofs of address, proof of trading/assets, and annual turnover per outstanding year received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Verify all directors on the CoR14.3 have provided certified IDs (< 3 months) and proofs of address, plus documentary proof of trading or assets/liabilities at deregistration.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Run 10-region Multiple Deeds Office search and verify KYC & trading proof
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Multiple Deeds Search across all 10 regional Deeds Offices completed and all KYC documents verified within 90 days
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check CIPC status (must be Final Deregistration for CoR 40.5; if AR Deregistration Process, you can skip CoR 40.5 and go straight to BO + Annual Returns!). Confirm whether the 10-region Deeds Search shows immovable property — if yes, ensure Dept of Public Works and National Treasury letters are obtained.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft CoR 40.5 form, Sworn Affidavit, Reinstatement Mandate & BO Register
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR 40.5 pack, Sworn Affidavit, Mandate, and BO Register drafted for Kevin review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Prepare the CoR 40.5 application, Sworn Affidavit detailing the reason for non-filing and active trading/assets, and combined Reinstatement + Beneficial Ownership Mandate.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send CoR 40.5, Sworn Affidavit and Mandate to client for signature and commissioning
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed CoR 40.5, commissioned Sworn Affidavit, and signed Mandate uploaded by client
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Instruct the director to sign the CoR 40.5 and Mandate, and sign the Sworn Affidavit in front of a Commissioner of Oaths / SAPS officer.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Compile single merged PDF dossier and lodge CoR 40.5 with CIPC (re-instatements@cipc.co.za)
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Merged 6-part PDF dossier emailed to re-instatements@cipc.co.za (or uploaded via e-Services) with R200 fee credit in CIPC customer account
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Merge the 6-part dossier into a single clean PDF (CoR 40.5, Certified IDs of directors + customer code owner, 10-region Multiple Deeds Search, Proof of trading/assets, DPW/Treasury letters if applicable, Sworn Affidavit & Mandate). Ensure R200 credit is available on the My Accountant CIPC customer code before emailing re-instatements@cipc.co.za.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC to process CoR 40.5 and change status to Reinstatement Process
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CIPC processes CoR 40.5 and opens the enterprise for BO and Annual Return catch-up filing
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Monitor CIPC status until the company moves from Final Deregistration to Reinstatement Process / In Business.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: File Beneficial Ownership Declaration and all outstanding CIPC Annual Returns
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Beneficial Ownership certificate issued and all outstanding Annual Returns + FAS filed on CIPC
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Within 30 business days of CoR 40.5 approval: (1) File the Beneficial Ownership declaration first on CIPC e-Services, then (2) Calculate and collect CIPC statutory Annual Return fees from the client if not pre-funded, and file every outstanding Annual Return + Financial Accountability Supplement.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver updated CoR 14.3 Disclosure Certificate ("In Business"), BO Certificate & AR Confirmations
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Updated CoR 14.3 showing "In Business", BO Confirmation, and Annual Return certificates posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Download the fresh CIPC Disclosure Certificate confirming the company is "In Business" and deliver the complete reinstatement pack to the client.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms company is fully reinstated to "In Business" status
